name: Amount Consistency Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies a type of amount inconsistencies, that the amount type provided matches the reference amount or not.

CONS.name: Consistent Amount
CONS.definition: Amount information matches the reference data record.

ICNS.name: Inconsistent Amount
ICNS.definition: Amount information does not match the reference data record.

ICGA.name: Inconsistent Charges Amount
ICGA.definition: Charges amount information does not match the reference data record.

ICFA.name: Inconsistent Confirmed Amount
ICFA.definition: Amount information confirmed to the creditor does not match the reference data record.

IISA.name: Inconsistent Interbank Settlement Amount
IISA.definition: Interbank settlement amount information does not match the reference data record.
